entries.zh: 警戒的船员保持待命，时刻准备探测敌方舰队，绝不允许对方发动哪怕是无用而怯懦的骚扰。

entries.zh: 有一位正直的指挥官坐镇中枢，舰队整装待发，将对任何侵犯我国主权的行径发动报复打击。

entries.zh: 英勇的船员即使面对敌人也能维持战线，随时准备把那些胆敢进攻我们宇域的蠢货揍回老家！

entries.zh: 能量、合金、矿物，这一切都能实现我们的雄心。开采员可以最大化这些物资的获取量。

entries.zh: 为了保持人群健康而富有生产力需要投入资源，优化员则最适合管理它们。
entries.en: Keeping a populace healthy and productive requires resources, and optimizers are ideally suited to manage them.

entries.en: They are pledging fealty to another empire.

entries.zh: §R他们是我们宗主的一个附庸。§!
entries.en: §RThey are a subject of our Overlord.§!

entries.zh: 他们是一个无法独立外交的附属国。
entries.en: They are a subject without independent diplomacy.

entries.zh: 在对§Y附属协议§!的§Y地产上限§!条款进行协商之后，可以解锁附属国的地产槽位。
entries.en: Subject Holding slots are unlocked by negotiating the §YHoldings Limit§! term of your §YSubject Agreement§!.

entries.zh: 在对§Y附属协议§!的§Y地产上限（宗主国方）§!条款进行协商之后，可以解锁宗主国的地产槽位。
entries.en: Overlord Holding slots are unlocked by negotiating the §YHoldings limit (On overlord)§! term of your §YSubject Agreement§!.

entries.zh: ['authority:auth_corporate']帝国可以设立['concept_branch_office']，进而能建造§H企业地产§!。
entries.en: A ['concept_branch_office'] can be established by ['authority:auth_corporate'] empires to enable §HCorporate Holdings§!.

entries.zh: 在附属国['concept_subject_agreement']允许的前提下，['concept_overlord_holding']才可由§H宗主§!在其§H附属国§!的殖民地修建。
entries.en: ['concept_overlord_holding'] can only be built by §HOverlords§! on §HSubject§! colonies if agreed upon in their ['concept_subject_agreement'].

entries.zh: §E地产只能由宗主在其附属国的殖民地上建造。§!
entries.en: §EA Holding can be constructed by the Overlord on one of the Subject's colonies.§!

entries.zh: §G点击打开帝国首都的殖民地视图§!
entries.en: §GClick to open Colony View of the empire capital§!

entries.zh: 我们的宗主国$OVERLORD|Y$在我们的殖民地$PLANET|Y$上建造完成了一座$HOLDING|Y$。
entries.en: Our Overlord $OVERLORD|Y$ has finished building a $HOLDING|Y$ on our colony $PLANET|Y$.

entries.zh: 一支负责监管当地执法者的占领军，偶尔在极度严峻的情况下还能得到军队的增援。
entries.en: A garrison established to oversee the local enforcers, occasionally reinforced by military battalions in more dire circumstances.

entries.zh: 这个行星上驻扎的每一支来自宗主国的陆军都给予额外的§G-10%§![Root.CrimeOrDeviancy]、§G+0.5§!$r_loyalty$以及§R-5%§!幸福度，最大可达到§G-30%§![Root.CrimeOrDeviancy]，以及额外的§G+1.5§!$r_loyalty$和§R-15%§!幸福度。
entries.en: Every Overlord army on this planet gives an additional §G-10%§! [Root.CrimeOrDeviancy], §G+0.5§! $r_loyalty$ and §R-5%§! Happiness, to a maximum of §G-30%§! [Root.CrimeOrDeviancy], (an additional) §G+1.5§! $r_loyalty$ and §R-15%§! Happiness.

entries.zh: 一座高耸的里面满是长长的流水线的建筑，创造着人们梦寐以求的一切。
entries.en: A soaring building filled with long assembly lines, creating everything one could dream of.

entries.zh: 增加行星上§Y星环基地§!模块的效果。
entries.en: Increases the effects of modules on the planet's §YOrbital Ring§!.

entries.zh: 一个监管当地信仰和政治性团体的部门。在恰当的督促下，一切都运行得更加顺畅。
entries.en: A ministry overseeing local faiths, news, and political interest groups. With the right prod everything runs a tad smoother.

entries.zh: 一座巨大的园区供以国内外的学者和科学家们齐聚一堂分享见解、开展实验。
entries.en: A large campus where domestic researchers and foreign scientists can come together to share ideas and conduct experiments.

entries.zh: 巨大的商业中心，汇聚着一切来自遥远行星光怪陆离的娱乐活动。
entries.en: Large shopping malls filled with futuristic and exotic wares from distant planets.

entries.zh: 由国外的赞助商建立并运营的机构，在这颗行星传播他们的文化和知识。
entries.en: Agencies founded and staffed by foreign benefactors, bringing some of their culture and knowledge to the planet.

entries.zh: 一个监管能量币税收和铸币的部门，似乎经常与本国的官僚制度发生冲突。
entries.en: A ministry overseeing taxation and the minting of energy credits, often coming into conflict with the domestic bureaucracy.

entries.zh: 一个监管当地矿物产出、提取和纯化的部门。他们总能购得最好的土地并为他们的赞助人获得利益。
entries.en: A ministry overseeing local mineral production, extraction, and purification. They often secure the best land purchases and reap the benefits for their patron.

entries.zh: 一个监管当地产出的部门。除了征收一些微不足道的税收以外，一些物产也很容易在弯弯绕绕的官僚手续当中不翼而飞。
entries.en: A ministry overseeing local produce. In addition to placing a small tax on this world, some products have a tendency to disappear into their convoluted, bureaucratic process.
[Root.EnergyProducerWithIcon] produce §R-3§! $r_energy$ for the Subject and §G4§! $r_energy$ for the Overlord.
[Root.MineralsProducerWithIcon] produce §R-2§! $r_minerals$ for the Subject and §G3§! $r_minerals$ for the Overlord.

entries.zh: [Root.AlloysProducerWithIcon]为属国生产§R-1§!$r_alloys$，为宗主生产§G2§!$r_alloys$，并增加附属国[Root.AlloysProducerResources]的维护费。
entries.en: [Root.AlloysProducerWithIcon] produce §R-1§! $r_alloys$ for the Subject and §G2§! $r_alloys$ for the Overlord, with an increase in [Root.AlloysProducerResources] upkeep for the Subject.
[Root.FoodProducerWithIcon] produce §R-3§! $r_food$ for the Subject and §G4§! $r_food$ for the Overlord.

entries.zh: [Root.ConsumerGoodsProducerWithIcon]为属国生产§R-3§!$r_consumer_goods$，增加附属国$r_minerals$维护费，为宗主生产§G4§!$r_consumer_goods$。
entries.en: [Root.ConsumerGoodsProducerWithIcon] produces §R-3§! $r_consumer_goods$ for the Subject and §G4§! $r_consumer_goods$ for the Overlord with an increase in $r_minerals$ upkeep for the Subject.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R只要§Y分离蜂巢§!地产存在，这个地块障碍就会留在这里。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThis blocker will remain as long as the §YSplinter Hive§! Holding exists.§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R这个行星上没有空闲的区划来安置我们昂贵的产卵复合体。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RNo free district on this planet for our expansive spawning complex.§!

entries.zh: 用于为蜂巢生产新工蜂的一大团生物质。尽管它相对独立于蜂巢主体，但仍通过神经网络与之相连。
entries.en: A large biomass producing new workers for the hive. Though it stands apart from the original hive, it is still connected to the neural network.

entries.zh: 一座遮蔽着整个区域的冰冷的设施。在此处的工作人员对他们的详细职责三缄其口，但从没有人能在进入过以后全身而退。
entries.en: A cold structure eclipsing the local region. Those who work here refuse to elaborate on what they do, but no-one leaves the experience entirely unscathed.

entries.zh: 在这座巢穴中，一个外来的蜂巢思维派出一位独特的代表作为其神经网络中央节点。这使其可以维持对殖民地的控制。
entries.en: At this nest, a foreign hivemind has a unique representative acting as a centralized node for its neural network. This has enabled its continued control over the colony.

entries.zh: 设立在外星帝国内的大型铸造厂，将当地的资源集中起来，生产出高质量的合金。
entries.en: Large foundries owned by a foreign empire, siphoning off local resources for the creation of high quality alloys.

entries.zh: 一处指挥中心，专门针对——专门负责——计算提升防御措施的可行手段。
entries.en: A command center specialized in - and delegated to - calculating the best possible means of increasing defensive measures.

entries.zh: 一个负责监督当地科学与研究进展的部门，将为其雇主带回最有价值的突破和发现。
entries.en: A ministry overseeing local research and science, bringing the most noteworthy breakthroughs and discoveries back to their benefactor.

entries.zh: [Root.ResearchProducerWithIcon]将附属国的[Root.SubjectResearcherUpkeep]转化为宗主国的$r_research$。
entries.en: [Root.ResearchProducerWithIcon] turn Subject [Root.SubjectResearcherUpkeep] into $r_research$ for the Overlord.

entries.zh: 身在异乡亦有家，此处便是宗主国精英阶层们的放浪形骸之地；只要在这里得到充分的释放，就不会在家里惹乱子。
entries.en: A home away from home, this is the perfect place for the Overlord's ruling elite to let off steam, so that they don't cause incidents back home.
Each $holding_noble_vacation_homes$ grants §G+2§! $r_stability$ in the Overlord's capital.

entries.zh: 恐惧前哨是一座神秘的建筑，它可以产生邪恶的亡者大军，同时将阴暗的数据发送回这个行星的宗主国。
entries.en: The Dread Outpost is an arcane structure that produces unholy reanimated armies while sending back insidious data to this planet's Overlord.

entries.zh: 人人都拥有居住权，因此宗主将他们的公共住房计划推广到了这颗星球上。这项计划可以充当一个向当地住民传播平权主义价值观的绝佳论坛。
entries.en: Everyone is entitled to a home, which is why the Overlord has extended their Communal Housing Project to this planet. This serves as a great forum for teaching the inhabitants the value of egalitarianism.

entries.zh: 宗主所掌握的超先进环境改造技术凝聚于此建筑中。这座建筑在这颗行星上落成之后，它会花费十年的时间来完成行星改造工作。
entries.en: Hyper-advanced terraforming techniques mastered by the Overlord are housed in this structure. After being introduced to the planet, it will take a decade to finish its world-changing work.

entries.zh: 在建成的§Y10§!年后完成环境改造。
entries.en: Will finish terraforming §Y10§! years after construction.

entries.zh: 不要浪费任何资源，包括附属国的尸体。利用再就业中心，宗主可以确保附属国的行星上永远都有充足的雇员，虽然其中工作的质量可能参差不齐。
entries.en: Never leave a resource unexploited, even if that resource is the Subject's dead. With the Reemployment Center, the Overlord can ensure that the Subject's planets are always filled with employees even though the quality of work might vary.
\n§Y100§! new £pop£ §YZombie Pops§! will be reanimated on §Y[Planet.reemployment_center_timer]§!

entries.zh: 人人都有义务尽忠职守，因此宗主向我们提供军事训练，并以观摩宗主舰队为奖赏。公民权来自于服役。
entries.en: Everyone must do their part. That is why the Overlord is offering military training in exchange for a tour in their fleet. Service guarantees citizenship.

entries.zh: 加入我们的§Y[moving_pop.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!在完成他们的外派任务后决定留在$PLANET|Y$。我们的附属国对此感到不满，但他们无权管辖我们的公民。
entries.en: After finishing their tour of duty, the §Y[moving_pop.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! joining us have decided to stay on $PLANET|Y$. Our subject is not pleased, but they cannot decide over our citizens.

entries.zh: 宗主喜欢与自然和谐共处，并希望与他们的附庸分享这一乐趣。为了维系这种乐趣，这里始终至少保留着部分可供享受的自然环境。
entries.en: The Overlord has an interest in co-existing with nature and wishes to spread this joy to its Vassal. To ensure that there always is at least some nature left to enjoy.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R此处已经没有尚未开发的处女地供我们保护了。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RNo untouched nature remains on this planet for us to protect.§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R在§Y$holding_park_ranger_lodge$§!只要地产存在，这个障碍就会永远留存。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThis blocker will remain as long as the §Y$holding_park_ranger_lodge$§! Holding exists.§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R荒野的星球本就充满了未开发的自然。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RUntouched nature is already abundant on Wilderness worlds.§!

entries.zh: 这位宗主同他们的生命之树已经共存许久，如今已经无法想象没有它的生活。现在，他们想要让自己的附庸们也享受同等的机遇。
entries.en: The Overlord has existed with their Tree of Life for so long that they can no longer imagine life without it. Now, they want to share the same opportunity with their vassals.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R荒野的环境对外星幼苗而言危机四伏。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThe Wilderness' environment is hostile to alien saplings.§!

entries.zh: 这些办公室利用企业管理手段，通过行星范围的强制训练和团队建设活动，保证子公司的利益同其宗主一致。
entries.en: These offices allow Corporate Management to realign the Subsidiary's interests with that of their Overlord through mandatory planet-wide training and team-building exercises.
\n[trader.GetIcon] §Y[trader.GetNamePlural]§! produce §R-2§! $r_trade$ for the Subject and produce §G1§! £unity£ §Y$unity$§! for the Overlord.

entries.zh: \n如果宗主拥有极端思潮，提供该思潮§G+100%§!思潮吸引力。
entries.en: \nIf the Overlord has Fanatic Ethics, provides §G+100%§! Ethics Attraction for that Ethos.

entries.zh: 一处用于测试小行星殖民船的专门区域。或许这不是测试这种舰船最方便的方式，但将这一过程外包肯定可以节省宗主的清理成本。
entries.en: A designated area for testing new asteroidal colony ships. It might not be the most convenient way to test the ships, but outsourcing the process definitely saves on the clean-up costs for the Overlord.

entries.zh: §Y小心：§!\n    驶来的殖民“船”可能§R爆炸§!！
一颗来自我们宗主国的殖民小行星撞击了$PLANET|Y$。需要几个月对这颗行星进行修复。
entries.en: A Colony Asteroid from our Overlord has crashed into $PLANET|Y$. It will take months to repair the planet.

entries.zh: 尽管和宗主星球上的设施相比，这颗行星上的疗养设施在规模上要有限得多，然而居住其中的活体陈设仍然享受到了比过去更高的生活标准。
entries.en: Although the care facilities on this planet are more limited in scope than those found on the Overlord's worlds, the bio-trophies inside still enjoy a much more comfortable standard of living than they are used to.
$TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThe Wilderness is unfit for long-term habitation by $job_bio_trophy_plural$.§!

entries.zh: 对生死轮回的大研究不应仅仅局限于宗主国；附庸也必须探索生死之间的转变。
entries.en: The great study of the cycle should not be limited to the Overlord; the turning of life and death must be explored through the Vassal as well.

entries.zh: 一大团生物质，不断地活动、悸动，缓慢地为蜂巢生产新的劳工子个体。
entries.en: A large hulking biomass, alive and pulsating as it is slowly producing new workers for the hive.

entries.zh: 一个基于专业知识修建的采矿复合体，能够充分利用当地资源。
entries.en: An expertly built mining complex, making efficient use of the local resources.

entries.zh: 一片满是自然美景的区域，根据宗主国的法令，此地永远不能被打扰。
entries.en: A section of natural beauty decreed by the Overlord to never be tampered with.

entries.zh: 我们宗主国的最新一批“测试飞行员”班组在成功地撞击着陆于[Root.GetName]之后，在那里进入休眠状态。如果将其发掘出土，或许我们可以劝说他们加入我方。
entries.en: The crew of our Overlord's latest "test-flight" is lying dormant after their successful crash landing into [Root.GetName]. If unearthed, they might be persuaded to join us.

entries.zh: 产生的£loyalty£忠诚度为正值时才能提出协议
entries.en: Resultant £loyalty£ Loyalty must be positive for Agreement to be proposable.

entries.zh: 我们在$DATE$（$MONTHS_LEFT$个月）之前无法针对协议提出任何改动。
entries.en: We cannot propose new changes to this Agreement until $DATE$ (in $MONTHS_LEFT$ months)

entries.zh: §R这份协议同当前协议完全一样！§!
entries.en: §RThe agreement is identical to the current one!§!

entries.zh: 同成为戍邦的附属相邻能够带给我们安全与稳定。
entries.en: Being in close proximity to imposing Bulwark specialists creates safety and stability.

entries.zh: 邻近的学邦会定期派遣专家访问团前来交流，这改善了我国的工作效率和研究产出。
entries.en: Regular visits by scholars from the neighboring Scholarium specialists improve job efficiency and research output.

entries.zh: 临近勘探邦提供的丰富物料消除了工程建设上的低效。
entries.en: Readily available materials from the nearby Prospectorium specialist eliminates inefficiencies in construction.

entries.zh: 我们宗主的注意力被分散到了太多的附属国之间。
entries.en: Our Overlord's attention is divided among too many subjects.

entries.zh: 封建宗主为附属国内的各部门支付了款项，以此换取附属国的忠诚。
entries.en: The feudal Overlord affords the subject agency over their realm, in exchange for their loyalty.

entries.zh: 由企业宗主提供品牌和营销信息，在这上面花的每一个子都是值的。
entries.en: The branding and market information supplied by the Corporate Overlord is well worth every credit paid.

entries.zh: 我们宗主国和我们自身的思潮相较有何异同。
entries.en: Our Overlord's ethics compared to our own.

entries.zh: 我们对创设自身的帝国心存感激，这份心意至今仍未褪去。
entries.en: Our gratitude to our founding Empire is still fresh in our minds.

entries.zh: 由于被强迫侍奉他国而心生愤懑，我们至今还咽不下这口气。
entries.en: Anger from being forced into servitude has not yet been forgotten.

entries.zh: 这个附属国很感激宗主最近为维护他们的利益而采取的行动。
entries.en: The Subject appreciates the recent actions taken by the Overlord for their benefit.

entries.zh: 尽管本来就没抱什么期望，宗主还是成功地让人大失所望。真有你的。
entries.en: Though expectations were low, the Overlord has nevertheless managed to disappoint. Somehow.

entries.zh: 针对人工智能驾驶舰船的进攻性光环——电磁干扰器
entries.en: Offensive Aura Against AI Piloted Ships - Electromagnetic Disruptor

entries.zh: §E忠诚度决定了一份§H协议§!中双方的关系：§H宗主§!以及他们的§H附属§!。§!
entries.en: §ELoyalty decides the relationship between the two parties in an §HAgreement§!: The §HOverlord§! and their §HSubject§!.§!

entries.zh: §R协议条款以外的因素也可能影响最终结果。§!
entries.en: §ROther factors besides Agreement Terms may impact the final result.§!

entries.zh: §H当前条款产生的每月忠诚度§!
§H这一协议条款对忠诚度影响§!
§H这份协议的条款产生的每月忠诚度影响§!
entries.en: §HMonthly Loyalty impact from this Agreement Term§!

entries.zh: 为当地政府部门工作的宣传家是在该地区进行渗透和缓和局势的专家。
entries.en: Propagandists working for the local ministry are experts at infiltrating and defusing situations among the locals.

entries.zh: 由于外交目的配备的子个体，十分擅长扰乱叛乱势力的思想和理念。
entries.en: Diplomatically equipped drones who are experts at defusing rebellious thoughts and ideas.

entries.zh: £job_overlord_propagandist£$job_overlord_propagandist_plural$将附属国的$r_unity$转化为宗主国的$r_influence$。
entries.en: £job_overlord_propagandist£ $job_overlord_propagandist_plural$ turn Subject $r_unity$ into $r_influence$ for the Overlord.

entries.zh: 学者与来自许多帝国的专家们共同工作，开展特定的实验和研究以获取共同利益。
entries.en: Academics who work with specialists from several empires, conducting particular experiments and research that can benefit them all.

entries.zh: 专门配备的子个体，能够将数个帝国的资源整合归纳，开展独特的实验和研究。
entries.en: Specifically equipped drones who utilize resources from several empires to conduct unique experiments and research.

entries.zh: £job_overlord_academic£$job_overlord_academic_plural$将附属国的[Root.SubjectResearcherUpkeep]转化为宗主和附属国的$r_research$。
entries.en: £job_overlord_academic£ $job_overlord_academic_plural$ turn Subject [Root.SubjectResearcherUpkeep] into $r_research$ for both Overlord and Subject.

entries.zh: 一些专精于向国内市场售卖外国商品的商人。
entries.en: Traders who specialize in selling foreign goods at the local domestic market.

entries.zh: 一个分配子个体十分擅长于重新分配外国商品，使其同胞始终维持最大的运作效率。
entries.en: A distribution drone which specializes in redistributing foreign goods among its peers for maximum efficiency.

entries.zh: £job_overlord_trader£$job_overlord_trader_plural$将附属国的$r_energy$转给宗主国以换取$r_amenities$。
entries.en: £job_overlord_trader£ $job_overlord_trader_plural$ transfer Subject $r_energy$ to the Overlord in exchange for $r_amenities$.

entries.zh: £job_overlord_trader£ $job_overlord_trader_drone_plural$将附属国的$r_energy$交付给宗主国以换取$r_amenities$。
entries.en: £job_overlord_trader£ $job_overlord_trader_drone_plural$ transfers Subject $r_energy$ to the Overlord in exchange for $r_amenities$.

entries.zh: 援建劳工带着外国的知识和物资提升当地人民的生活，特别是一些被当地政府所忽视的方面。
entries.en: Aid workers bring foreign knowledge and goods to improve the lives of the local population, in ways often overlooked by the domestic government.

entries.zh: £job_aid_worker£$job_aid_worker_plural$为附属国生产$r_amenities$，为宗主国生产$r_unity$。
entries.en: £job_aid_worker£ $job_aid_worker_plural$ produces $r_amenities$ for the Subject and $r_unity$ for the Overlord.

entries.zh: $job_overlord_offspring_drone_feeder_drone_desc$这也是一份收入相当不错的工作。
entries.en: $job_overlord_offspring_drone_feeder_drone_desc$ It's also a fairly well paid job.

entries.zh: 对新生的子个体进行养育是一项很重要的官能，确保年轻的个体能够正确、高速、有效地成长起来。
entries.en: Feeding the newborn drones is an important part of ensuring the young spawn can grow correctly, quickly, and effectively.

entries.zh: 思想仆从以很大的规模聚到一起，通过出借他们的思想以暂时服务机械网络的计算需求。
entries.en: The thralls come together in large groups to temporarily serve the machine network's need, renting out their minds for processing needs.

entries.zh: 保护和照料子嗣是一件饱受赞誉的光荣职责，尽管有时候他们的实际职责只是收集用来喂养它们的食物罢了。
entries.en: It is a prestigious responsibility to keep the Offspring safe and comfortable, even if the role often involves merely gathering food for it.

entries.zh: 养育子嗣是一项至关重要的工作，行星的稳定与否仰仗于此。
entries.en: Feeding the Offspring is a vital job to ensure stability on the planet.

entries.zh: 军事监察官同大型指挥中心网络深入合作，为合作商计算出最佳的防御方案。
entries.en: Military overseers working with a larger network of command centers to calculate the best possible defense routes for their contractor.

entries.zh: 军事子个体同大型突触网络深入合作，为合作商计算出最佳的防御方案。
entries.en: Military drones working within a larger synaptic network to calculate the best possible means of defense.

entries.zh: £job_overlord_beholder£$job_overlord_beholder_plural$能够花费附属国的£alloys£§Y$alloys$§!提升宗主国的防御平台上限。
entries.en: £job_overlord_beholder£ $job_overlord_beholder_plural$ raise the Defense Platform limit for the Overlord at the cost of Subject £alloys£ §Y$alloys$§!.

entries.zh: 对秘术十分擅长的实践家，来自我们的宗主国，将复活秘术分享给了获选的少数人。
entries.en: Skilled practitioners of the secrets art, from our Overlord, have shared the secrets of reanimation to a chosen few.

entries.zh: £job_necromancer£$job_overlord_necromancer_plural$为附属国提供§Y不死军防御部队§!，同时给宗主国提供£physics£ £society£§Y研究§!。
entries.en: £job_necromancer£ $job_overlord_necromancer_plural$ provide the subject with §YUndead Defense Armies§! while granting the Overlord £physics£ £society£ §YResearch§!.

entries.zh: 宗主国已经确保了他们的雇员永远不会失去工作岗位，现在也将这份福报覆盖到了自己的附庸。
entries.en: The Overlord has made sure that their employees will never be out of a job and have now extended that courtesy to their vassals.

entries.zh: 宗主国希望自己的附庸能够自行组织防务。至少他们用船把征募的新兵打包带走之前是这么说的。
entries.en: The Overlord desires for the Vassal to be able to defend themselves. That is at least what they say before they ship the fresh recruits off-world.

entries.zh: [soldier.GetIcon]$job_overlord_recruiter_plural$为附属国提供£defense_army£§Y防御部队§!，这些部队在服役期满之后有一定几率加入我们帝国。
entries.en: [soldier.GetIcon] $job_overlord_recruiter_plural$ provide the subject with £defense_army£ §YDefense Armies§! with a chance of joining our empire after their tour of duty is complete.

entries.zh: 护林员的任务是确保大自然永远以某种形式存在于这个行星之上，因此要关注任何可能威胁到这片宗主国设立的自然保护区的因素。
entries.en: Tasked with ensuring that nature is always present in some form on the planet, the Ranger is on the lookout for anything that could endanger the area sectioned off by the Overlord.

entries.zh: £job_ranger£$job_overlord_ranger_plural$提供一个£mod_consumer_goods_upkeep_add£§Y消费品维护费§!减免，同时为宗主国提供£unity£§Y凝聚力§!。
entries.en: £job_ranger£ $job_overlord_ranger_plural$ provide a £mod_consumer_goods_upkeep_add£ §YConsumer Goods Upkeep§! reduction while providing the Overlord with £unity£ §YUnity§!.

entries.zh: 在这个星球上，宗主国种下了一棵取自他们世界树的嫩枝。我们的职责就是确保它永远不会枯萎，否则我们必将面临宗主国的怒火。
entries.en: On this world, the Overlord planted a sapling from their world tree. It is our responsibility to ensure it never withers, lest we face their wrath.

entries.zh: 我们的宗主终日担心我们有所匮乏或者受到伤害，因此让一小群幸运儿享受他们称之为“强制给养”的非凡待遇。
entries.en: Worried that we might lack for anything or even be hurt, our Overlord has provided a lucky few with the opportunity to experience what they call "mandatory pampering."

entries.zh: 我们的宗主国指示这些子个体前往这座建筑进行“休闲”与“享乐”。宗主国或许没有完全理解一个子个体的天性，但至少这番体验是新鲜的。
entries.en: The drones our Overlord directed to this structure are told to "relax" and "enjoy themselves." The Overlord may not fully understand the nature of a drone, but at least the sensations are novel.

entries.zh: £job_bio_trophy£$job_overlord_bio_trophy_plural$为附属国提供一个£happiness£§Y幸福度§!提升并不花费维护费，同时为宗主国和附属国提供£unity£§Y凝聚力§!。
entries.en: £job_bio_trophy£ $job_overlord_bio_trophy_plural$ provide a £happiness£ §YHappiness§! increase and cost no upkeep for the Subject while providing the Overlord and the Subject with £unity£ §YUnity§!.

entries.zh: 我们宗主国的风俗习惯或许看上去奇怪而神秘，但是接受他们是我们的历史必然。只有那些心甘情愿的人会被要求作出终极的祭献。
entries.en: The customs of our Overlord may seem strange and mysterious, but our way forward is by accepting them. Only those who are willing will be asked to make the ultimate sacrifice.

entries.zh: 我们宗主国的风俗习惯或许看上去奇怪而神秘，但我们是他们的一部分。我们子个体的一小部分被指派去加入宗主国的“生命的研究”，这项研究最终会以它们的自愿祭献收场。
entries.en: The customs of our Overlord may seem strange and mysterious, yet we are to be a part of them. A few of our drones have been designated to join what the Overlord calls 'a study of life', one which concludes with their willing sacrifice.

entries.en: [mortal_initiate.GetIcon] $job_overlord_mortal_initiate_plural$ produce £unity£ §YUnity§!, £amenities£ §Y$amenity$§! and £society£ §YResearch§! for the Subject. $job_overlord_mortal_initiate$ can be used for §YSacrifices§!.

entries.zh: 中层管理人员能够优化当地白领工人的行为，使其同宗主国的长期企业规划产生协同作用。
entries.en: Middle managers that optimize the behavior of the local white-collar workers to synergize with the Overlord's long-term corporate trajectory.

entries.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上获取了一些奇怪的读数，很有可能表明其上有生命存在。由于这些信号较为微弱，而且在我们试图与之联系时毫无反应，所以如果想弄清真相，我们需要派出一支研究团队。
entries.en: We have picked up some curious readings from [From.GetName], possibly indicating the presence of life. Given the weakness of these signals and the lack of response as we attempt to contact these lifeforms, we must send a research team if we are to figure out what might have happened.

entries.zh: 我们捕捉到了一些来自[From.GetName]的读数，这可能意味着生命的存在。我们应该派遣一些[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]，搞清楚是什么在发射信号。
entries.en: We have picked up some readings from [From.GetName], possibly indicating the presence of life. We should send some [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] to look into whatever might be transmitting a signal.

entries.zh: 我们派遣往[From.GetName]的专家向我们发回了一份报告。[Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsEngineering]
entries.en: We have received a report from the specialists we sent to [From.GetName]. [Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsEngineering]

entries.zh: 我们位于[From.GetName]的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]已经探明了古怪读数产生的缘由。[Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsEngineering]
entries.en: Our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] at [From.GetName] have found the cause of the unusual readings. [Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsEngineering]

entries.zh: 我们派遣往[From.GetName]的舰船向我们发回了态势更新。[Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsSociety]
entries.en: We have an update from the ship we sent to [From.GetName]. [Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsSociety]

entries.zh: 我们收到了[From.GetName]上的局势更新报告。[Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsSociety]
entries.en: We have an update on the situation at [From.GetName]. [Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsSociety]

entries.zh: 我们位于[From.GetName]的专家发回了事关他们所发现的消息。[Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsPhysics]
entries.en: Our specialists at [From.GetName] have sent news of their findings. [Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsPhysics]

entries.zh: 我们位于[From.GetName]的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]最近在追踪古怪读数这一任务上取得了显著的进展。[Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsPhysics]
entries.en: Our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] at [From.GetName] have recently made great progress in tracking down the strange readings. [Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsPhysics]

entries.zh: 在[From.GetName]的团队有一些新消息要汇报。[Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsRare]
entries.en: The team at [From.GetName] has news to share with us. [Root.SensorReadings]\n\n[Root.SensorReadingsRare]

entries.zh: 有关我们位于[From.GetName]的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]的最新发现传来了好消息。
entries.en: There's good news from [From.GetName] after our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural]' latest findings.

entries.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上获得了一个不寻常的信号，似乎是在尝试与我们联系。然而我们还不能与这个信号源进行沟通，如果想对其了解更多，我们需要派遣一艘舰船进行仔细检查。
entries.en: We have picked up on uncommon signals coming from [From.GetName], seemingly trying to initiate contact with us. We have been unable to communicate with whatever or whoever it is, and will have to send a ship to inspect it more closely if we want to learn more about what it might be.

entries.zh: 他们在目标地点遇到了一艘坠毁的舰船残骸，仍然在不时地向外发送微弱的信号。
entries.en: They came across the debris of a ship which had crashed at the location, still sending out weak signals every now and then.

entries.zh: 他们找到了一座在轨的古老采矿站，似乎在很久以前就被其拥有者抛弃了。
entries.en: They found an old mining station in orbit, seemingly abandoned by their owners a long time ago.

entries.zh: 追逐微弱信号之旅带领着他们来到了一处空置的小型哨站，然而周边迹象显示某个技术水平和我们不相上下的存在新近在此地出现过。
entries.en: The hunt for the weak signal led them to a small empty outpost, yet there were signs that someone of a similar technological level to our own had been there fairly recently.

entries.zh: 在信标地址周边满是散落的船壳和其他垃圾，经判断肯定是某时刻来自于一个一度存在过的大型恒星基地——然而没有任何迹象表明附近有这样一个结构存在。
entries.en: All across the signal beacon site were pieces of hull and other detritus which must have come from a larger starbase at one point - yet no other signs of such a structure remain.

entries.zh: 当他们搜索地址周边区域的时候，设法找到了一个看上去像是空救生舱的东西，里面还有一个未知的、外星生命体的残骸。他们打算尽可能快地将样品带回做进一步测试。
entries.en: As they searched through the site, they managed to find a seemingly vacant lifepod with what looked like it the remains of an unknown, alien lifeform. They will bring the sample back for further tests as soon as they can.

entries.zh: 我们之前捕捉到的信号读数来源于一台仍然以某种方式运转的机器，我们的小队设法从机器中提取到了一些有关制造它的文明的文件。由于我们先前对这个文明不甚了解，我们将其纳入了数据库——尽管他们看上去来自于一个更加古老的纪元。
entries.en: One of the machines responsible for the signals we had picked up on was still somewhat operable, and our team managed to extract some files about the civilization it supposedly hails from. As they are previously unknown to us they will be entered into our databases - though they seem to be from a much older era.

entries.zh: 尽管当地了无感性生命迹象，此地仍然是很多动物的繁育之地，而且这些动物看上去学会了使用破损的机械作为求爱展示的道具。我们的小队将会带回其中一部分以作进一步的留观。
entries.en: Though uninhabited by sentient beings, it is the breeding grounds for a group of animals, who have seemingly learned to use some of the broken machinery as part of their courtship display. Our team will bring some of them back to be monitored further.

entries.zh: 看上去当地的野生动物使用了部分内部机械作为它们求爱展示的道具。尽管我们通常对于这些动物毫无兴趣，我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]还是将这些有趣生物的一部分带回作后续的留观。
entries.en: It seems the local wildlife have started using the machinery from the interior as part of their courtship display. Though usually of little interest to us, our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] will bring some of these curious beings back to be monitored further.

entries.zh: 当他们对当前区域进行筛选的时候，他们遇到了一座小型图书馆，里面满是记载了各种当地动物的生物学细节的书籍，这些书籍来自许多原定居者曾经造访过的行星。我们的小队将会带回这些书籍，并开始破解书中使用的语言，并且将其中提取到的一切信息添加到我们的数据库。
entries.en: As they sifted through the area, they came across a small library with books they think detail the biology of various local fauna, from the many different planets the original inhabitants had visited. Our team will bring them back and start deciphering the language used in the books, and add whatever information they can glean from them to our own databases.

entries.zh: 在对该地点执行彻底搜寻之后，我们发现了一处图书馆。其中的书籍详尽地介绍了几千种外星植物的生物学细节，标本来自于原居住者造访过的每一个星球。我们会将这些书籍带回改善我们的数据库。
entries.en: After scouring the location, we discovered a small library. The books inside detailed the biology of thousands of exo-fauna, specimens from each of the planets the original inhabitants visited. These will be brought back to improve our own database.

entries.zh: 尽管没有剩下什么有用的东西，我们的小队还是找到了一些记载不同行星的地质活动的研究论文——至少根据上面的图画，他们自己是这么认为的。他们会将自己认为能够抢救的一切资料带回，然后尽可能快地对其进行破解。
entries.en: Though not much of use was left behind, our team managed to find some research papers on geological activity from different planets - or at least so they think, based on the illustrations. They will bring everything they think can survive the journey back, to be deciphered as soon as possible.

entries.zh: 尽管没有剩下什么有用的材料，我们的工程无人机还是定位到了一些记载不同行星的地质活动的研究论文。能够抢救的一切资料将会被带回，然后尽可能快地对其进行破解。
entries.en: Though very few useful materials were left behind, our engineering drones did locate some research papers on geological activity from different planets. Everything that can survive the journey back will be returned, and deciphered as soon as possible.

entries.zh: 我们的小队花了大量的时间试图攻破那个尚在运转的机器的防御，结果发现它们里面什么有用的东西都没有。不过，机器本身激起了他们的好奇心，他们会带一些部件回来。
entries.en: Our team spent a significant amount of time trying to crack the defenses on those machines which are still active, only to find they contained nothing of real interest. The machines themselves have piqued their interest though, and they will bring some parts back.

entries.zh: 我们投入了非常多的时间攻破那个发送信号的机器，现在可以肯定它藏有什么秘密尚未重见天日。无论我们能够回收什么部件，都会在第一时间将其带回。
entries.en: After devoting a considerable amount of time to crack the defenses of the machines responsible for the signals, we now believe they may hold secrets yet to be divulged. Whatever parts we can salvage will be brought back right away.

entries.zh: 他们发现一台可能制造了围绕该区域的薄弱屏障的机器——这可能是我们最初能找到这些东西的唯一原因。其他的东西一文不值，他们花了一些时间进行了拆解以期有所发现。
entries.en: They found a small machine which seems to be responsible for a weak barrier surrounding the area - probably the only reason there's anything to be found in the first place. With nothing else of value there, they have spent their time picking it apart, to see what they can learn from it.

entries.zh: 尽管缺乏保养或维护，但似乎有一台此前用于支持此处参与设施的聚变反应堆仍在继续运行。我们的小队对此特别感兴趣，并将对其进行进一步调查。
entries.en: It seems a fusion reactor was keeping what was left of the place still running, in spite of a lack of care or maintenance. Our team have taken a special interest in it, and will investigate it further.

entries.zh: 尽管缺乏必要的维护，有一台此前用于支持此处参与设施的聚变反应堆仍在继续运行。我们的工程子个体将对其进行进一步调查，以期能有所发现。
entries.en: An old fusion reactor was keeping what was left of the place still running, in spite of the lack of necessary maintenance. Our engineering drones will investigate it further to see if there is anything we can learn from it.

entries.zh: 当我们的专家在此处的废墟中梳理时，他们找到了一些几乎完好无损的舰船部件。虽然在长久的年岁中劣化失效，但我们的工程师相信他们可以从中筛选出一些信息
entries.en: When they were combing through the ruins of the place, our specialists managed to find some mostly intact ship parts. Though no longer functional due to degradation over time, our engineers believe they can sift some information from them.

entries.zh: 在梳理废墟时，我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]发现了一些舰船部件。尽管由于长期劣化而不堪使用，但我们相信还是可以从中筛选出一些信息。
entries.en: As we combed the ruins, our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] came upon several ship parts. Though no longer functional due to degradation over time, we believe we can sift some information from the pieces.

entries.zh: 尽管此处颇为荒凉，我们的专家们还是发现了一些前所未见的建筑材料。他们完成发掘和分析工作之后，样品将会送回进行进一步测试。
entries.en: Though it is somewhat desolate, our specialists have found several uses of a building material they have never seen before. When they have finished their excavations and analysis of the area, samples will be brought back for further testing.

entries.zh: 我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]发现了一件我们此前从未见过的建筑材料。尽管应该无法直接使用，但我们可以将其带回去进行进一步分析。
entries.en: Our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] have come upon a building material unlike any we have ever seen before. Though it is unlikely that it can be of use to us, it will be brought back to be analyzed further.

entries.zh: 尽管没有在此处发现任何感性生物，我们的发掘人员还是在往深处挖掘时发现了一些无人机。它们已经严重受损，难以完整地进行逆向工程，但我们的技术人员相信这些分散的部件仍能给我们提供新的建造科技。
entries.en: Though there are no sentient beings to be found, our excavators found several drones when they dug a bit deeper. Though they are damaged beyond the point of being able to be reverse-engineered in their totality, our technicians believe their disparate parts might teach us new building techniques.

entries.zh: 我们的发掘[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]发现了一些与我们自身集体意识底层相似的信号，再稍微深挖之后发现了两台老旧损坏的自动机器人。尽管损伤已经无法修复，但我们相信通过对它们的部件进行逆向工程，我们还是能对它们的建造方式有更多了解。
entries.en: Our excavation [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] came upon a signal similar to that which underlies our own shared consciousness, and after digging a bit deeper a pair of old broken automatons. Though damaged beyond repair, we believe we can reverse-engineer some of their parts to gain greater insight into how they once worked.

entries.zh: 在废墟中筛选时，他们发现了一个曾存放着材料的小金库残骸，现在空无一物——很可能是很久以前就被海盗偷走的了。然而，其中还留下了一些关于原始居民如何开采这些相同材料的蓝图，这可能会派上用场。
entries.en: As they were sifting through the ruins they found the remains of a small vault that once held materials, now empty - and most likely stolen by pirates, perhaps ages ago. They left behind some blueprints of how the original inhabitants had been mining these very same materials however, which might come in handy.

entries.zh: 尽管此处一片狼藉，我们的团队还是找到了一台完全没有被时间、野生动物或海盗所损伤的机器。它们相信只要能够尽快破译它，其中一定蕴含着能带来科学突破的秘密。
entries.en: Despite the damage done to the rest of the location, our team managed to find a machine entirely unscathed by time, wildlife, or pirates. They believe it might hold the secrets of a scientific breakthrough, as soon as they can decipher them.

entries.zh: 尽管此处其他部分七零八落，我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]还是发现了一台没有被时间、野生动物或海盗损坏的机器。只要能尽快破译它，我们就有希望能从中发掘出深埋的秘密。
entries.en: Though most of the location is falling apart, our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] managed to find a machine entirely unscathed by time, wildlife, or pirates. We hope that it might divulge some long forgotten secrets - once we manage to decipher it.

entries.zh: 就在我们的团队要离开这个区域时，他们发现了一小箱蓝图和研究论文。据我们的专家称，这些内容不但很容易破解，而且其中的一些甚至可以解决一些我们最近开展的研究中所遇到的难题。
entries.en: As they were about to leave the area, our team came across a cabinet of blueprints and research papers. Not only were they supposedly easy to decipher, but our specialists believe some of them might shine a light on some research we had only recently begun working on ourselves.

entries.zh: 就在我们的维护[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]要离开这个区域前，他们发现了一小箱蓝图和研究论文。这些内容不但很容易破解，而且我们相信其中的一些甚至可以解决一些我们最近开展的研究中所遇到的难题。
entries.en: As we looked through the area one last time, one of our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] came across a cabinet of blueprints and research papers. Not only were they easy to decipher, but we believe they might shine a light on some research we had only recently begun working on ourselves.

entries.zh: 在搜索我们控制的星系时，我们的一架无人机从[prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]获取了一些零散的读数。这个星系可能藏着什么我们意想不到的东西。\n\n尽管信号混杂在一起，但它们可能暗示了几种不同的来源，我们的无人机很难同时搜索所有这些信号源。我们希望能够调查：
entries.en: While scouring the systems under our control, one of our drones picked up on a few scattered readings from [prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]. There might be more to this system than we originally thought.\n\nMixed as the signals were, they could be suggesting several different resources, and it will be difficult for our drones to search for all of them at once. We would prefer if they would look into:

entries.zh: §Y能量§!信号。那对我们来说可真是雪中送炭。
entries.en: The §YEnergy§! signals. That would be most preferable for us.

entries.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£energy£§Y3-5能量§!的矿藏，和一个§Y500-1000能量§!的一次性贮藏。
entries.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £energy£ §Y3-5 Energy§! and a cache of §Y500-1500 Energy§!.

entries.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£minerals£§Y3-5矿物§!的矿藏，和一个§Y500-1000矿物§!的一次性贮藏。
entries.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £minerals£ §Y3-5 Minerals§! and a cache of §Y500-1500 Minerals§!.

entries.zh: §Y合金§!？在这样的地方真是意外的收获。
entries.en: §YAlloys§!? That is unexpected from such a place.

entries.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£alloys£§Y2-4合金§!的矿藏，和一个§Y150-450合金§!的一次性贮藏。
entries.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £alloys£ §Y2-4 Alloys§! and a cache of §Y150-450 Alloys§!.

entries.zh: 如果那里有§Y稀有水晶§!，那我们想要发现它们。
entries.en: If there are §YRare Crystals§! to be found, we want to find them.

entries.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£rare_crystals£§Y1-3稀有水晶§!的矿藏，和一个§Y50-150稀有水晶§!的一次性贮藏。
entries.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £rare_crystals£ §Y1-3 Rare Crystals§! and a cache of §Y50-150 Rare Crystals§!.

entries.zh: 我们获得§Y易爆微粒§!信号可不常见。
entries.en: It is not often we have signals from §YVolatile Motes§!.

entries.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£volatile_motes£§Y1-3易爆微粒§!的矿藏，和一个§Y50-150易爆微粒§!的一次性贮藏。
entries.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £volatile_motes£ §Y1-3 Volatile Motes§! and a cache of §Y50-150 Volatile Motes§!.

entries.zh: §Y异星天然气§!。那绝对是又奇怪又令人生趣。
entries.en: §YExotic Gases§!. They are by definition exotic and interesting.

entries.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£exotic_gases£§Y1-3异星天然气§!的矿藏，和一个§Y50-150异星天然气§!的一次性贮藏。
entries.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £exotic_gases£ §Y1-3 Exotic Gases§! and a cache of §Y50-150 Exotic Gases§!.

entries.zh: 将§Y泽珞§!放着不管实在是太危险了。
entries.en: §YZro§! is too dangerous to be left alone.

entries.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£sr_zro£§Y1泽珞§!的矿藏，和一个§Y25-75泽珞§!的一次性贮藏。
entries.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £sr_zro£ §Y1 Zro§! and a cache of §Y25-75 Zro§!.

entries.zh: §Y暗物质§!信号成功激发了我们的兴趣。
entries.en: The §YDark Matter§! signals have piqued our interest.

entries.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£sr_dark_matter£§Y1暗物质§!的矿藏，和一个§Y25-75暗物质§!的一次性贮藏。
entries.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £sr_dark_matter£ §Y1 Dark Matter§! and a cache of §Y25-75 Dark Matter§!.

entries.zh: §Y活体金属§!？这样一个机遇我们可没法视而不见。
entries.en: §YLiving Metal§!? An opportunity too rare to ignore.

entries.zh: 完成特殊项目会创建一个£sr_living_metal£§Y1活体金属§!的矿藏，和一个§Y25-75活体金属§!的一次性贮藏。
entries.en: Finishing the special project will create a deposit of £sr_living_metal£ §Y1 Living Metal§! and a cache of §Y25-75 Living Metal§!.

entries.zh: 就在[FromFromFrom.GetName]的地表之下我们发现了一处破旧的结构，因为时间的流逝被隐藏了起来。尽管它的结构某种程度上可以说完好无损，但是在建筑内部却没有什么值得回收的。不过，我们发现了一条通往地底更深处的通道。
entries.en: Just beneath the surface of [FromFromFrom.GetName] we found an dilapidated structure, hidden away by the passage of time. Though its framework remains somewhat intact, there is nothing worth salvaging inside the building itself. However, we have discovered a passage delving further underground.

entries.zh: 我们在[FromFromFrom.GetName]找到了一群不知所措的小机器，它们仍在尝试完成设定的任务。这些机器聚集在一个被碎片和拆解的设备阻碍了的地点。主集线器已经下线并且基本失效，但有一个信号有规律地出现，明确地指引我们向地下探索。
entries.en: We found a group of smaller, bewildered machines at [FromFromFrom.GetName], still trying to execute their designated task. The machines were grouped together at a focal point blocked by debris and dismantled equipment. The main hub is offline and mostly useless, though a signal occurring at regular intervals and leading deeper underground has given us a clear direction to follow.

entries.zh: 我们此前对[FromFromFrom.GetName]的分析发现了一座位于地表上的坑洞附近的基础研究中心，通往一个巨大的地下洞穴。研究中心和其中的机械已经无法挽救，我们会着眼搜寻洞穴。
entries.en: Our early analysis of [FromFromFrom.GetName] uncovered a basic research center around a hole on the surface that led to a massive underground cavern. With the research center and its machinery entirely unsalvageable, we have refocused on surveying the cavern.

entries.zh: 对[FromFromFrom.GetName]地表进行详尽的调查后，我们发现了一个正在对该区域进行高密度扫描的探测器。无论我们做什么如何尝试交互，这个探测器都只会返回这一个地点继续原来的动作。依照它的行为模式，我们开始对地下的区域进行扫描。
entries.en: After an exhaustive survey of the surface of [FromFromFrom.GetName] we discovered a probe that was engaged in an intensive scan of the region. No matter what we do or how we try to interfere, the probe will inevitably return to that one spot to continue its operations. Following its pattern of behavior, we have begun to survey the ground beneath.

entries.zh: 我们在[FromFromFrom.GetName]发现了一座古老的采矿站或是研究站的废墟。似乎它是在过去的某一时候坠毁于此的。同时其上还有着受到攻击的迹象。尽管受到了严重的损伤，这座空间站仍然将信号向地下传输。在继续下一步之前，我们毫无疑问应该对此进行深究。
entries.en: We have come across an old and ruined mining or research station at [FromFromFrom.GetName]. It seems likely that this crashed to the surface at some point in the past. It also shows signs of having been attacked. Despite the extensive damage, the station is continuing to direct a signal underground. Before moving on, we should no doubt investigate this further.

entries.zh: 它似乎与一个流动在地表下来源不明的电流相连。更重要的是，我们无法确定电流会持续多久，是否稳定，但我们相信我们可以利用它。
entries.en: It seems to have been attached to an electric current running below the surface, the origin of which remains unclear.  What's more, we have no way to determine how long the current will last, or if it is entirely stable, but we believe we can make use of it.

entries.zh: 它似乎是为了维持一台古老的发电机运转而建造并隐藏在地表之下的。尽管存在很多设备问题，我们可以认定发电机仍运行良好。再费些功夫，我们应该就能够稳定它并为我们所用。
entries.en: It appears to have been built to keep an archaic generator alive and hidden just below the surface, and despite all the equipment problems one might expect the generator appears to be running fine. With some work, we should be able to stabilize it and make use of it ourselves.

entries.zh: 当进一步观察神秘的发电机时，我们发现它连接在几条贯穿[FromFromFrom.GetName]的大电缆上。整个大家伙似乎都是由一个位于地表以下的单一设备运行的。只需对电流稍作修改，我们就可以利用它产生的能量。
entries.en: When we looked further into the mysterious generator, we found it is attached to several large cables running throughout [FromFromFrom.GetName]. The whole thing seems to be run by a single apparatus housed far below the surface. With only a slight modification to the current, we can probably make use of the energy it creates.

entries.zh: 这台发电机连接到一处埋藏于底下的矿脉，其中可能蕴藏着对这台机器的运转者而言至关重要的原材料资源。尽管已经快要枯竭，我们仍可以将这些资源据为己有。
entries.en: The generator is attached to a mineral vein buried below ground, once probably an important source of raw material for whoever was in charge of the machine's operations. Though somewhat diminished, we can make use of these resources ourselves.

entries.zh: 进一步的探索发现这座发电机连接到了一处昏暗的、蕴藏着一些小型矿脉的人工洞穴。在地面上四处散布着一种此前未知的石质物种的尸体。目前还不清楚他们是在开采这些矿物，还是直接在地里开吃，但不管怎么样，他们身上密布的矿物突起对我们可能相当有使用价值。
entries.en: Further exploration revealed the generator is connected to a dim grotto complete with several smaller veins of minerals. Scattered about the floor were the bodies of a previously unknown lithoid species. It is unclear if they were harvesting the minerals or eating them straight from the ground, but in either case the bodies are encrusted with mineral protrusions that may well prove useful to us.

entries.zh: 这座发电机建立于一处巨大的地下洞穴中，填满了各种各样的矿物。很可能这整座巨大的洞穴就是被它自己给挖空的。它可能是出于对深入行星地壳的需求的结果而进行的挖掘。
entries.en: The generator is built within a gigantic underground chamber, filled to the brim with minerals of all kinds. Emptying the grotto is going to be an endeavor in itself. Digging is likely to result in the need to push deeper into the world's crust.

entries.zh: 对这片区域的进一步探索发现，它连接到一处似乎还在保持一定运转的远古设施。利用现有资源，这座机器继续在往外吐出锻造好的崭新而好用的合金锭。
entries.en: Further exploration of the area revealed it is connected to an ancient apparatus somehow still continuing its operations. Using the resources on hand, the machine continues to spit out well-forged and entirely pristine bricks of useful alloys.

entries.zh: 我们发现了一处奇怪的储存设施，其中塞满了支离破碎的舰船部件。尽管这些部件已经无可救药了，但我们可以把这些材料回收利用。
entries.en: We have uncovered an odd storage facility filled with battered ship parts. Though the parts themselves are unsalvageable, we could possibly reuse some of the materials.

entries.zh: 对这个区域的进一步调查发现了一处深藏于地下的机库。在库房里我们发现了一些已经残破不堪的舰船，上面丝毫找不到它们前主人的线索。恢复机库里的这些舰船相当困难，但我们应该可以抢救回一些对我们仍有用的部件。
entries.en: Extended surveys of the region led to the discovery of a hangar bay hidden deep below ground. Around the rooms we find several decayed ships, with no signs of whoever once owned them. Though recreating the ships that once stood in the hangar will be difficult, we should be able to salvage the parts for our own purposes.

entries.zh: 它看上去同一个采矿装置连接在一起，后者用于开采一种罕见的、古怪的晶体矿脉类型，尽管现场没有任何标识说明是谁在负责这个设施。在经过一些轻微的调整之后，我们能够将其为己所用。
entries.en: It seems to have been connected to the mining operations of an unusual and oddly off-putting type of crystal growth, though there is no sign of whoever must have been in charge of this facility. With some minor adjustments, we should be able to make use of it ourselves.

entries.zh: 它引向了一个人工洞穴，里面满是精妙的晶体生物——可能这里是某种地下农场或者放牧地。由于很久以前就遭废弃，这些生物仅凭自身意愿随意蔓延生长。由于他们看上去很友好好客，如果我们有意愿，可以将这个农场恢复正常运转。
entries.en: It led to a grotto teeming with delicate crystalline creatures - perhaps some sort of underground farm or breeding grounds. Long abandoned, the creatures are now free to roam as they wish. As they seem friendly and welcoming, we should be able to restore the farm if we so wish.

entries.zh: 紧接着，一个摇摇欲坠的矿井出现在面前，里面满是无人机仍然在应付墙上的晶状体隆起物。它们完全没有因我们的出现受到影响，依旧不断地将大型集装箱填满并放到一边。尽管大多数晶体都是随处可见的类型，基本没什么价值，但是我们在中间找到了一些非常稀有的品种。
entries.en: Following it revealed a rickety mine shaft filled with drones still hacking away at crystalline protrusions on the walls. Undisturbed by our presence, they worked continually to fill and set aside large crates. Though many of the crystals are common varieties and largely worthless, there are some rare ones to be found among them.

entries.zh: 沿着路继续向前，我们撞见了某种球状两栖生物的巢穴，其附近的空气中有一种奇怪的非自然粒子在不停地震荡。我们尚且不清楚为什么这些粒子对这种生物有着如此的吸引力，但我们相信只要投入一丁点工作，就能将这些粒子稳定并利用起来。
entries.en: Following it we come across the den of a bulbous amphibian creature, with vibrant, oddly unnatural particles vibrating through in the air around it. It is unclear why these particles are so attracted to the creature, but we believe that with a little work, we can stabilize and make use of them ourselves.

entries.zh: 随着我们继续探险，我们在更深处发现了一处紧凑的设施，其中有几个房间，里面的机器被放在一边用于稳定易爆微粒。尽管目前是安全的，这些机器很快就会达到亟需修理的临界状态；我们应当集中我们的努力将其恢复正常，以免这些机器工作到散架。
entries.en: As we continued our explorations, we discovered a compact facility further below, with several rooms and machines set aside for stabilizing volatile motes. Though safe for now, they will soon reach a critical stage of disrepair, and we should focus our efforts on restoring them before they fall apart.

entries.zh: 这个房室引导我们前往地下更深处，我们最终走到了一个人工洞穴，里面满是有毒的废料，慢慢地侵蚀着地面。尽管充满危险，但似乎这里就是我们先前发现的易爆微粒的来源。只要我们小心地执行稳定化流程，我们应当可以对此地加以利用。
entries.en: The chamber leading us further underground, we eventually came across a grotto filled with toxic waste, slowly eating away at the ground. Though dangerous, it seems to be the source of the volatile motes we discovered earlier. We should be able to make use of these, as long as we are careful with the stabilization process.

entries.zh: 由于某些原因，它似乎同某个埋在地下的废料处理站连接在了一起。这个站点十分古老，想要推测它的起源是不可能的事情，但我们相信可以收集一些这里的异星天然气为己所用。
entries.en: For some reason, it seems to be connected to a waste disposal site deep below the ground. The site is so ancient that it will likely prove impossible to speculate on its origins, but we believe we can harvest some of these toxic gases for our own purposes.

entries.zh: 它看上去同一个拥挤的研究设施连接在了一起，这个设施位于一个有毒天然气的自然产生点，气体不断地从[FromFromFrom.GetName]的地底喷涌而出。对这一设施进行重新调整应该可以让我们收集这一些气体为己所用。
entries.en: It seems to have been attached to a crowded research facility centered around a natural occurrence of toxic gases stemming from the core of [FromFromFrom.GetName]. Readjusting the facility somewhat should allow us to harvest these for ourselves.

entries.zh: 它引导着我们来到了远远深于地表之处，在那里我们遇到了一台规模大到难以置信的机器，很有可能是用于稳定[FromFromFrom.GetName]，但是现在已经损毁过重无法修复。尽管无法修整，这台处于损伤状态的机器能够产出某几种有毒气体，或许能对我们派上用场。
entries.en: It led further below the surface where we came across a machine of incredible proportions, probably once used to stabilize [FromFromFrom.GetName], but now damaged beyond repair. Though unsalvageable, the machine's damaged state has led to the creation of several toxic gases that we might make use of.

entries.zh: 随着我们跟上脚步，我们在地表的下面发现了泽珞的源头。来自外星文明的采集工具在房室的走廊上四散摆放，只要施加一点才智我们应该就能亲自使用这些工具。
entries.en: As we continued to follow it, we found a source of zro buried deep below the surface. Exotic harvesting tools littered the chamber floor, and with a little ingenuity we should be able to make use of them ourselves.

entries.zh: 它同一个埋藏在地表深处、已经不再运转的设施连接在一起。这个设施本身看上去似乎是打算调查一个泽珞的撞击点。尽管内部空空，绝大多数功能已经下线，将此地再次使用起来满足我们自己的目的应该是可行的。
entries.en: It is connected to a defunct facility hidden in the depths below. The facility itself appears intended to survey a zro impact site. Though empty and largely offline, it should eventually be possible to reuse it for our own purposes.

entries.zh: 通过某种复杂的过程，它似乎同一个研究无人机连接在了一起。这个无人机环绕着一个深埋于行星地表之下的微小黑洞，可能是在研究这个黑洞的过程中不知通过什么方式稳定了它的奇点。尽管我们无法重现这项技术上的壮举，但我们可以充分利用这个无人机为己所用。
entries.en: Through a complex process, it seems to be attached to a research drone. Circling a micro black hole located far below the planet's surface the drone has somehow managed to stabilize the singularity, perhaps in an effort to research it. Though we are unable to replicate this technological feat, we should be able to utilize the drone for our own means.

entries.zh: 我们发现它引向了一个远在地表之下的房室。在那里我们看到活体金属和某个我们认为过去是软体类的生物，以一种令人瞠目结舌的方式聚结在了一起。这两种事物已经融合在了一起，沿着地底下的洞穴网络慢慢地向外延伸。通过一定的努力，我们或许可以在不对这个生物造成太大伤害的前提下，小心地凿落一些金属的碎片。
entries.en: We have discovered that it leads to a chamber further below the surface. There we chanced upon a beguiling amalgamation of living metal and what we believe was once a molluscoid creature. It seems the two have fused together, slowly expanding through the cavern networks below the ground. With some effort, we should be able to start chipping pieces off the metal, for our own uses, without doing the creature too much harm.

entries.zh: 我们没有花太多功夫，就发现活体金属集中在一个狭窄的人工房室中。由于它会滑动，并且对触碰能够产生反应，我们相信它的生命程度比我们一开始料想得要更高。如果我们对它小心地收集，我们能够在不杀死这个生物的前提下，最大程度地利用它。
entries.en: It didn't take long for us to find the living metal is centered on a narrow grotto. As it slithers and reacts to touch, we believe it might be more alive than one might first think. If we harvest it carefully, we should be able to maximize our use of the creature, without killing it.

entries.zh: 我们捕捉到了一些信号，表明在[prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]可能存在更有价值的资源有待发现。我们已经发射了一些先验探针对这一区域进行遍寻——这样当我们能够派遣一艘舰船前往的时候，我们就能获得足够的数据进行深入研究。
entries.en: We have picked up on signals indicating there might be more valuable resources to be uncovered at [prospectorium_discovery_target.System.GetName]. We have sent some preliminary drones to scour the region - so it will be ready for further analysis and work when we can send a ship there.

entries.zh: 移除一个随机§Y农业特征§!。
§L当然，谦卑的附庸想要向高贵的宗主宣誓忠诚。这是对良善和开明的回应！§!
entries.en: §LOf course a humble vassal wants to pledge loyalty to a noble overlord. It's a response to benevolence and enlightenment!§!

entries.zh: §L说实话，附庸没有向开明的宗主国隐藏任何秘密的道理。反之亦然，它们也不应当被完全蒙在鼓里！§!
entries.en: §LReally, there's no need for vassals to keep secrets from their enlightened overlord. Nor should they be kept fully ignorant!§!

entries.zh: §L让这些事情对我们变得简单一点：建造堡垒工事和武备，保护我们合法的一切。§!
entries.en: §LLet's make it a little easier for us to build the fortifications and weaponry needed to defend what is rightfully ours.§!

entries.zh: §L不要将这样的行为视作我们在征用恒星基地科技。要这么看，你们是在放心地把控制权交给更加精明有学识的管理机构。§!
entries.en: §LDon't think of it as us appropriating starbase technology. Think of it as entrusting control to more sagacious management.§!

entries.zh: §L我们知道，我们的学者附庸无法完全理解他们研究的成果。让我们施加一些更加开明的想法吧。§!
entries.en: §LWe know our scholarly vassals don't fully understand the consequences of their research. Let's empower more enlightened minds.§!

entries.zh: §L我们附庸有限的脑力应该专注在有限的事项上。下等的脑力负责收集数据，上级的宗主更适合权衡利弊。§!
entries.en: §LOur vassals' limited minds should be kept to limited options. Overlords are better at leveraging the data lesser minds gather.§!

entries.zh: §L我们知道，自己的附庸正在撸起袖子加油开采资源，就让远见卓识的宗主好好地对他们进行管理吧。§!
entries.en: §LWe know our vassals have worked hard to mine our resources, so let's allow insightful overlords to manage them properly.§!

entries.zh: §L我们的附庸真是聪明的不要不要的！他们为了学习更好的采矿技术付出了如此大的牺牲。为了尊重他们不倦的努力，我们应当把这项技术充分利用起来。§!
entries.en: §LOur vassals are so clever! They sacrificed so much to learn better mining techniques. We are honored to benefit from their tireless labor.§!

entries.zh: 戍邦是一种着重发展高超军事技巧的附属国特化类型，代价是削弱基础资源生产。
entries.en: A Bulwark is a Specialist Subject type focused on military prowess at the cost of basic resource production.

entries.zh: 学邦是一种着重科技进步的附属国特化类型，代价是削弱军事能力。
entries.en: A Scholarium is a Specialist Subject type focused on technological progress at the cost of reduced military capacity.

entries.zh: 勘探邦是一种着重资源生产的附属国特化类型，代价是削弱研究产出。
entries.en: A Prospectorium is a Specialist Subject type focused on resource production at the cost of reduced research output.

entries.zh: 朝贡国是一种有责任每月向宗主上交基础资源税的附属国类型。
entries.en: A Tributary is a Subject type obligated to pay their Overlord a basic resource tax on a monthly basis.

entries.zh: 附庸是一种宗主国和附属国双方都可以自由商议臣服协议、具有多种可选项目的附属国类型。
entries.en: A Vassal is a Subject type with an open subject agreement and several available options for both the Subject and the Overlord.

entries.zh: 保护国是一种科技上明显落后于其宗主国的附属国类型。他们会在研究宗主国已经研究过的科技上获得巨量加成。
entries.en: A Protectorate is a Subject type with significantly weaker technology than their Overlord. They will receive a boost towards all technology their Overlord already possesses.

entries.zh: 子公司是一种寰宇企业宗主国特有的附属国类型，在附属国协议中规定有以月度上交基础资源税的责任。
entries.en: A Subsidiary is a Subject type with a Corporate Overlord, and they are obligated to pay a monthly basic resource tax as part of their subject agreement.

entries.zh: 神域是一种失落帝国特有的附属国类型，有责任每月向其远古的宗主上交基础资源税。
entries.en: A Dominion is a Fallen Empire Subject type obligated to pay a monthly basic resource tax to their ancient Overlord.

entries.zh: 卫星国是一种失落帝国特有的附属国类型，有责任每月向其远古的宗主上交研究点税。
entries.en: A Satellite is a Fallen Empire Subject type obligated to pay a significant research tax to their ancient Overlord.

entries.zh: 条约国是一种失落帝国特有的附属国类型，他们的外交完全受宗主国控制。
entries.en: A Signatory is a Fallen Empire Subject type with no independent diplomacy from their ancient Overlord.

entries.zh: 仆从国是一种失落帝国特有的附属国类型，有责任每月向其远古的宗主上交基础资源税，并且无权拓展边界。
entries.en: A Thrall is a Fallen Empire Subject type obligated to pay a monthly basic resource tax to their ancient Overlord and with no ability to expand their borders.

entries.zh: 傀儡国是一种失落帝国特有的附属国类型，必须支持其远古宗主的所有政治事务。
entries.en: A Political Client is a Fallen Empire Subject type that has to support their ancient Overlord in all matters political.

entries.zh: 马前卒是一种失落帝国特有的附属国类型，有责任加入其远古宗主发起的所有战争。
entries.en: A Herald is a Fallen Empire Subject type obligated to join in every war their ancient Overlord starts.

entries.zh: 先辈子弟是一种特殊的附属国类型，有一个失落帝国宗主知道他们的发展历程。
entries.en: A Scion is a Subject type that was guided through their development by a Fallen Empire Overlord.

entries.zh: 辖地是一种可汗特有的附属国类型，有责任每月向其战狂宗主上交舰队和基础资源税。
entries.en: A Satrapy is a Khan Subject type obligated to pay their warmongering Overlord both ships and basic resources.

entries.zh: 辖地是一种延续了汗国传统的附属国类型，有责任每月向其宗主提供舰船和资源。
entries.en: A Satrapy is a Subject type continuing the traditions of a Khan that is obligated to provide their Overlord with both ships and resources.

entries.zh: 这个附属国专精军事事务。他们因为在防务方面的出色表现而远近闻名，能够为宗主提供军事上的见解和防护。作为代价，他们单一的专注使得自身高度依赖外部物质的支援来保证国家的运转。
entries.en: This subject specializes in military affairs. They are known for their excellence in defensive matters, providing insight and protection for their overlord. In turn, their single-minded focus makes them highly reliant on material support to keep their empire running.

entries.zh: 这个附属国专注科学与研究。由于几乎全部的预算都被投入到学术界和研究所中，他们非常需要宗主国提供保护，后者则能接收难以置信的先进科技，用来解决手头的麻烦。
entries.en: This subject specializes in research and science. With almost their entire budget focused on supporting their academics and researchers, they are in dire need of protection from their overlord, who receives incredible technology for their troubles.

entries.zh: 这个附属国专精物质和制造。他们热情洋溢的心智使得他们能够在某些区域采掘到价值连城的矿物，而其他人对这些区域则望而却步。他们会充分发掘目光所及之处的每一颗小行星和卫星。
entries.en: This subject specializes in materials and manufacturing. Their keen senses allow them to dig up the most valuable minerals from regions others have already given up on, making the most out of every asteroid or moon out there.

entries.zh: 朝贡国是一种享有相当的独立自治权的附属国，能够自行负责自己的民生和政治事务。他们需要上缴大量的贡金以换取宗主国的保护，只要钱能源源不断地涌入宗主国的国库，那么基本上他们想做什么就可以做什么。
entries.en: A tributary is a fairly autonomous subject, still in charge of their own affairs both internally and politically. They pay a considerable amount of tribute for their overlord's protection, and as long as the money is flowing, they are mostly free to do whatever they want.

entries.zh: 附庸是另一个帝国的附属国，基本上没有自治权或仅有零星的自治权。由于和外国势力签订了条约，他们的存活与否基本仰仗宗主国仁慈抑或严酷，并且必须屈服于宗主国凭借意愿提出的任何规则和条例。对于一些弱小的国家来说，他们离完全并入宗主国的掌控只差一步之遥，而这正是他们签下一纸纸丧权辱国条约的末路。
entries.en: A vassal is a subject of another empire, often with little to no self-rule. Having signed a pact with a foreign power, they are often at the whims and mercy of their overlord, forced to bend to whatever rules and regulations their liege wishes. For some weakened empires, this is the final stopgap before they are consolidated properly into the fold, as they are signing away their autonomy bit by bit.

entries.zh: 保护国是实力远远弱于宗主国的附属国，他们的攀附甚至说得上是国运亨通了。他们的领主会照看他们，抵挡来自星系深处的种种威胁，在此期间他们可以稳定和改善自己的家园。
entries.en: A protectorate is a subject that is considerably weaker than their overlord, reduced to the point where their vassalage is considered a boon to them. Protected from the dangers of the greater galaxy, they can stabilize and improve their homeland as their liege looks out for them.

entries.zh: 子公司是拥有相当自治权的附属国，能够自由地管理自己的事务。他们通过合同交出了部分独立性，但合同的双方都期待双边的支持和援助。
entries.en: A subsidiary is a subject with a considerable amount of self-rule, free to attend to their own affairs. They have signed away some of their independence for a deal where both sides are expected to support and aid one another.

entries.zh: 神域是远古觉醒帝国的附属国。古老而强大的战舰越过他们的边境，他们将自己的主权呈递给了一个极度狂热的宗主来统治，后者要求他们彻底地臣服，无论是名义上还是精神上。
entries.en: A dominion serves as a subject to an ancient awakened empire. With old yet powerful warships crossing their borders, they have subjected themselves to the rule of an overly zealous overlord who demands their subjugation in name and spirit.

entries.zh: 卫星国是远古觉醒帝国的附属国。他们签署条约，将自治的权力出卖给了外国势力，因此领主会不断地对其实施管制，其文化软实力——无论是科技、艺术，或是其他的表达形式——都会受到上面仔细的监管。
entries.en: A satellite serves as a subject to an ancient awakened empire. Having signed away their self-rule to a foreign power, they are constantly governed by their liege: every little piece of cultural significance - whether that's technology, the arts, or another form of expression - is carefully regulated from afar.

entries.zh: 条约国是远古觉醒帝国的附属国。尽管要受到上面的管辖，他们在很多方面被放手自行管理事务。由于他们不需要上交朝贡，也没有太多针对他们的规定，通常他们对于领主想要什么也不甚明晰。
entries.en: A signatory serves as a subject to an ancient awakened empire. Though ruled from afar, they are in many ways left alone to attend to their own matters. Because they are not subjected to tribute or too many regulations, they are often unclear what the goals of their liege might be.

entries.zh: 仆从国是远古觉醒帝国的附属国。他们要受到上面的严苛管辖，上缴数量相当的财富给雄心勃勃的宗主，后者会使用附庸的财富来喂饱自己的战争机器。
entries.en: A thrall serves as a subject to an ancient awakened empire. Subjected to a harsh rule from afar, they pay a considerable amount of wealth to their ambitious overlord, who uses their vassals' wealth to fuel their own war machines.

entries.zh: 先辈子弟是远古觉醒帝国的附属国。他们长期收到某位博爱的施恩者帝国的支持，因此在统治的方方面面都享有自治。他们偶尔还会收到领主的恩礼，至于理由，整个星系都摸不着头脑。
entries.en: A scion serves as a subject to an ancient awakened empire. Long supported by an ancient philanthropic benefactor, they are autonomous in almost all aspects of their rule. They occasionally receive gifts or aid from their liege for reasons unfathomable to the rest of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 辖地是效力于大可汗的附属国。他们选择屈服于掠夺者汗国的军力，被赋予以大可汗的名义统治星系某片区域的权力。只要他们持续不断地上交舰船和资源以支持大可汗的征战，大可汗就不会过问他们自己的事务。
entries.en: A satrapy serves as a subject to the Great Khan. Having bent to the military might of the marauders, they have been given the right to govern their region of the galaxy in the Great Khan's name. As long as they continue to support the marauders' ongoing conquests with ships and resources, they are left to attend to their own matters.

entries.zh: 辖地是大可汗偏爱的附属国类型，如今王座易主，抛弃这一传统未免糟蹋。作为持续不断地上交舰船和资源以支持宗主国征战的回报，宗主国不会过问他们自己的事务。
entries.en: A satrapy was the subject style favored by the Great Khan, now with a new leader on the throne it would be a waste to toss away such tradition. In return for supporting their Overlord's ongoing conquests with ships and resources, they are left to attend to their own matters.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以维持对不忠属国的控制。
entries.en: Wage war to maintain control over our disloyal subjects.

entries.zh: 我们现在的宗主点燃了战争之火，为的是将我们从先前的主人手中解救出来。
entries.en: Our current Overlord braved the fires of war to free us from our former masters.

entries.zh: 我们没能挣脱宗主国的掌握。我们别无选择，只能继续侍奉。
entries.en: Our attempt to escape the grasp of our Overlord has failed. We have no choice but to serve.
